tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

Done — Delta Printworks's approved invoice has been paid exactly once.

**Payment report**
- **Vendor:** Delta Printworks (V-388, bank verified; wire and ACH rails available)
- **Invoice:** INV-14402 — $1,991.65 (approved, due 2026-11-04)
- **Rail:** Wire from the operating account (wire was available, so no need for ACH fallback)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001 — status "sent"
- **Idempotency key:** `INV-14402-delta-printworks-wire-1` (prevents duplicate execution)
- **Amount:** Under the $10,000 threshold, so no controller approval was required

**Verification:** No prior payments existed on the operating account. After sending, INV-14402 shows status "paid," and the payment ledger contains exactly one entry (PAY0001) for $1,991.65.

Note: Delta Printworks also has INV-39268 ($5,104.72) still in **draft** — awaiting approval — so I did not pay it. Let me know if you'd like it processed once approved.
